title: Add new release repositories
author: johnwason
body:
* Name of the release team: robotraconteur

* Release repositories to add: 
  * https://github.com/robotraconteur-packaging/robotraconteur-ros-release
  * https://github.com/robotraconteur-packaging/robotraconteur-ros2-release
  
  * [robotraconteur](https://github.com/robotraconteur/robotraconteur)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/9d89561fcb48e294847437a0c7be955bd724e893/rolling/distribution.yaml#L5819)
    * [x] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: <https://github.com/robotraconteur-packaging/robotraconteur-ros2-release>

comments.author: johnwason
comments.body: I am also planning on submitting a few more related packages in the next few weeks/months. Should I create release repositories in my org or here?

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body: The previous release repositories have been mirrored into ros2-gbp/robotraconteur-release. I recommend archiving the previous repositories to leave them available but prevent pushing new artifacts to them unintentionally.
